description: This file defines classes, enums, and functions related to notification forwarding policies within an Android application. It includes configuration modes, filtering logic for packages, quiet hours handling, and rate limiting for notification bursts.

classes.name: NotificationForwardingPolicy
classes.description: A data class encapsulating the policy configurations for notification forwarding, including enabled state, mode, package set, quiet hours, and rate limit.

classes.name: NotificationBurstLimiter
classes.description: A class providing rate limiting functionality for notification events within a time window.

methods.name: NotificationPackageFilterMode.fromRawValue
methods.description: Converts a raw string value to the corresponding filter mode enum.

methods.name: NotificationForwardingPolicy.allowsPackage
methods.description: Checks if a given package name is allowed or blocked based on the current policy mode and package set.

methods.name: NotificationForwardingPolicy.isWithinQuietHours
methods.description: Determines if the current time (or specified epoch time) falls within the configured quiet hours.

methods.name: normalizeLocalHourMinute
methods.description: Normalizes a raw time string to the 'HH:MM' format if possible.

methods.name: parseLocalHourMinute
methods.description: Parses a normalized time string into the total minutes from midnight.
